SELECT p.id, p.name, p.tag, p.selling_point, p.garm, p.sales, p.owner_type, p.sale_mode, MIN(i.price) AS price, MAX(i.origin_price) AS origin_price, (SELECT img.url FROM product_image img WHERE img.product_id = p.id ORDER BY img.sort LIMIT 1) AS image_url, (SELECT i2.condition_grade FROM product_item i2 WHERE i2.product_id = p.id ORDER BY i2.price ASC LIMIT 1) AS condition_grade FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_item i ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 1
AND MATCH(p.name, p.selling_point, p.tag) AGAINST (#{q.keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
AND p.category_id = #{q.categoryId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_item d WHERE d.product_id = p.id AND d.origin_price > d.price)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_item c WHERE c.product_id = p.id AND c.condition_grade = #{q.conditionGrade})
GROUP BY p.id
HAVING TRUE AND price >= #{q.priceMin} AND price <= #{q.priceMax}
ORDER BY price ASC ORDER BY price DESC ORDER BY p.sales DESC ORDER BY p.id DESC
SELECT name FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND MATCH(name, selling_point, tag) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) GROUP BY name ORDER BY MAX(sales) DESC LIMIT 10
